name: Canada Rare Earth Corp.
summary: Canada Rare Earth Corp., a development stage company, engages in the exploration and development of rare earth elements in North America and Asia. Its products include high-purity rare earth oxides, rare earth fluorides, larger particle/nano rare earth oxides, and other products. The company was formerly known as Rare Earth Metals Inc. and changed its name to Canada Rare Earth Corp. in February 2013. Canada Rare Earth Corp. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
